claims.text: The Clinton Presidential Library holds a FOIA collection (2006-0480-F) consisting of correspondence between President Clinton and Laurance Rockefeller.

edges.label: The initiative worked the Clinton White House while Podesta was Staff Secretary and later Chief of Staff
edges.note: Podesta held senior White House staff positions throughout the initiative's life and has since publicly and repeatedly demanded UFO declassification, including at the National Press Club on 22 October 2002.

edges.label: Rockefeller financed and directed the 1993-1996 disclosure initiative
edges.note: Rockefeller Family & Associates funded the effort, its briefing document and its distribution to officials and heads of state.
